svg.title: Customs shipment evidence graph at the port of entry
svg.desc: Evidence graph of one e-commerce shipment at the port of entry. Blue boxes are authority facts, green boxes issuer-signed evidence, solid arrows digest links, dashed arrows authority checks, orange arrows the evidence used by the release decision. The data model is reconstructed from the public pilot demonstration.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Customs shipment evidence graph at the port of entry

Evidence graph of one e-commerce shipment at the port of entry. Blue boxes are authority facts, green boxes issuer-signed evidence, solid arrows digest links, dashed arrows authority checks, orange arrows the evidence used by the release decision. The data model is reconstructed from the public pilot demonstration.
